subject: One-time transient usage credit request — ApertureAI pilot
messages:
From: Alex Martin <alex@aperture.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-21T14:12:00Z
Subject: Spike in trial usage — request for one-time onboarding credit

Rishi —

Quick note from our side: since switching a portion of our traffic to Redwood test endpoints, we hit a sudden spike in token consumption (attached). This was unexpected for a pilot and will blow the team’s budget this month.

Would Redwood consider a one-time onboarding credit to cover the overage and let us complete the pilot through the end of September? We’re still committed to moving to a paid tier if the next month looks steady — we have legal/PO constraints that delay payment until mid-September.

Attached: aperture_usage_snapshot-20260821.csv

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to jump on a quick call.

— Alex
Alex Martin
Head of Data Ops, ApertureAI
alex@aperture.ai
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
To: Alex Martin <alex@aperture.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-21T15:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in trial usage — request for one-time onboarding credit

Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sending the usage snapshot. I’ve looped Marissa and Marcus to request a one-off credit approval. Quick context for the internal thread: customer requesting a one-time credit to cover an unexpected trial overage (projected ~$18k). They expect PO mid-September and are committed to a paid tier thereafter.

I’m attaching a quick proposed credit calc (20% of current overage, capped at $20k) as a starting point. If Marissa/Marcus are ok with the terms, I’ll draft a short amendment / revised SOW and send to Aperture with the PO deadline and scope limitation.

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc-v1.xlsx

Next steps asked of internal: decision on one-time credit amount, any legal/finance clauses to add (timebound, one-off, non-precedent).

— Rishi
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.example
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-22T09:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in trial usage — request for one-time onboarding credit

Rishi —

Thanks for escalating. Need the business justification in the form I can take to CFO: 1) expected incremental ARR if Aperture converts next quarter; 2) why this is not a platform misconfiguration (ops risk); 3) customer referenceability / logos.

Also confirm the exact requested credit amount and timeline (is it a retroactive invoice credit or a pre-pay invoice waiver?). If we proceed, I'll need a one‑paragraph memo I can forward to leadership and finance.

Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Cc: Alex Martin <alex@aperture.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in trial usage — request for one-time onboarding credit

Marissa —

Summary for memo (copy/paste friendly):
- Customer: ApertureAI (pre-seed to Series A AI startup; in discussions for enterprise contract).
- Ask: One-time onboarding credit to cover trial overage of ~$18,200 (Aperture requested full coverage). Our proposal: 20% credit of documented overage, capped at $20,000, applied as a retroactive invoice credit.
- Rationale: Usage surge caused by an unanticipated production-style traffic pattern during pilot (customer says they directed production traffic to test endpoints by mistake). They have signaled intent to convert to a 12-month commitment starting Oct 1 pending PO. Estimated first-year committed ARR: $220k if converted.
- Referenceability: Customer is willing to be a named reference and participate in a short case study if pilot success criteria met.
- Conditions: Credit is one-time, applies only to invoices dated Aug 2026, not precedent-setting, and requires a signed amendment (SOW) and PO submission by 2026-09-15.

I attached the proposed_credit_calc-v1.xlsx with the numbers and the usage snapshot Alex sent.

If that looks ok I can convert into a one-paragraph memo for Marissa to forward to finance/CFO.

— Rishi
From: marcus_lin@redwood.example
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-24T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in trial usage — request for one-time onboarding credit

Team —

Reviewed the numbers and the conversion case. Finance is prepared to authorize a conditional one-time credit: 20% of the documented overage, capped at $20,000, as a retroactive credit to the August invoice. Conditions: (1) signed amendment/SOW that specifies the credit amount and explicitly notes this is a one-time accommodation and not a model for future contracts; (2) customer PO or payment commitment by 2026-09-15; (3) credit will be applied after verification of usage records.

I’ll sign off to clear this for Rishi to commit to the customer once Marissa gives the greenlight to proceed. From a finance perspective, include a line in the SOW that credit is non-refundable and not to be used against future invoices beyond the agreed period.

— Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example
To: Alex Martin <alex@aperture.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-24T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in trial usage — request for one-time onboarding credit

Alex —

Good news: we can approve a one-time onboarding credit. Terms below — please confirm acceptance by reply so we can circulate a short amendment: 

- Credit: 20% of verified overage, capped at $20,000 (estimated credit ~$3,640 based on provided snapshot).
- Application: Retroactive credit on August 2026 invoice, applied after verification of usage.
- Conditions: Signed amendment/SOW accepting the credit terms; PO or written payment commitment by 2026-09-15; credit applies only to this one-time event.
- Next steps: I’ll attach a draft revised SOW and the credit calc. If you confirm, please sign the amendment and share the PO by 09/15.

Attachments: revised-sow-draft.pdf, proposed_credit_calc-v1.xlsx

Thanks — we want to keep the pilot smooth and get you to a stable paid phase.

— Rishi
Account Exec — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
